svg.text: Figure R1: Selective Segmentation System Architecture (Component A)
Uncertainty-Guided Selective Segmentation: Multimodal Encoders, PVL Adapters, Spatial Stencil Triage, and Offline Verification

g.text: • Downward / Upward Projections: W_v^↓, W_t^↓, W_v^↑, W_t^↑
• Cross-Modal Fusion: Dot product Z_v ⊙ φ(Z_t) + Bilinear Upscale ψ
• Mean Probability: P_mean(x, y) = (1/T) ∑_{t=1}^T P_t(x, y)
• Predictive Shannon Entropy: ℋ(x, y) = -P_mean ln P_mean - (1-P) ln(1-P)
• Predicted binary mask Ŷ is NOT an uncertainty score
• Ŷ acts as an anatomical spatial stencil: Ω_fg = { (x,y) | Ŷ(x,y) == 1 }
• Defends against global dilution: Background tissue is quiescent
• Isolates model dissonance strictly to the predicted lesion candidate
• Zero denominator catch: if |Ω_fg| == 0, U_fg is mathematically undefined (0/0)
Calibrated exclusively on BUSI Validation at 80% coverage target
Separates confident normal scans from subtle missed lesions
• U_fg > 0.064058 OR (Empty & U_mean > 10⁻⁴) → Divert to radiologist
Runtime Outputs vs. Decoupled Offline Validation
• Triage Flag: ACCEPTED vs REVIEW REQUIRED
• Decision Telemetry: U-score, Operating Tau, Lesion Area
Accepted != Proof of correct segmentation; indicates low model ambiguity.
Manual radiologist annotations; ONLY available during benchmarking.
• Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC): +0.0745 ID, +0.0939 OOD Gain
• Normalized Surface Distance (NSD): Verifies boundary accuracy
• Risk-Coverage Dynamics: Monotonic risk drop as coverage falls
• Area Under Risk-Coverage (AURC): U_fg achieves 0.0839 on Val
• Paired Bootstrap CI (B=1000): ΔAURC vs U_std_fg = -0.0011 (p=0.884)
• Area Confounding Check: U_mean ρ = +0.9148 vs U_fg ρ = -0.085
Validated on 5 Multimodal Ultrasound Cohorts (Total N=542 scans)
